title: Revisiting a Fast Newton Solver for a 2-D Spectral Estimation Problem: Computations with the Full Hessian
summary: Spectral estimation plays a fundamental role in frequency-domain identification and related signal processing problems. This paper revisits a 2-D spectral estimation problem formulated in terms of convex optimization. More precisely, we work with the dual optimization problem and show that the full Hessian of the dual function admits a Toeplitz-block Toeplitz structure which is consistent with our finding in a previous work.
